lines.text: Joab fought against Rabbah of the Ammonites and captured the royal fortress.
Joab sent messengers to David saying he had captured the water supply and told him to assemble the rest of the troops.
David assembled all the troops and went to Rabbah, and he fought against it and captured it.
David took the crown from the head of the Ammonites' king, and it weighed a talent of silver.
David put the people to work with saws, iron picks, and axes, and then he and all his troops returned to Hebron.
